topic.title: Vast Tracing & Flow Control
topic.description: Deeply nested loops, recursion tracing, complex switch fallthroughs, and long execution paths.

questions.title: Recursive Fibonacci Tracing
questions.explanation: f(3) prints 3. It calls f(2) and f(1). f(2) prints 2, then calls f(1) and f(0). f(1) prints 1. f(0) prints 0. Back to f(3), it calls its second branch f(1) which prints 1. Total: 3, 2, 1, 0, 1.

questions.title: Nested Loop Break/Continue
Switch Case Waterfall
questions.explanation: k=1. case 1: sum becomes 2. Fallthrough to case 2: sum becomes 7. if (7 > 6) break! Execution breaks out of the switch. Final sum is 7.

questions.title: Mutually Recursive Functions
questions.explanation: A(4) -> prints A4, calls B(3). B(3) -> prints B3, calls A(1). A(1) -> prints A1, calls B(0). B(0) -> returns. Total: A4B3A1.

questions.title: Static Variable in Recursion
questions.explanation: rec(3): val=3, calls rec(2). rec(2): val=3+2=5, calls rec(1). rec(1): val=5+1=6, calls rec(0). rec(0): returns val(6). All recursive unwinds return 6.

questions.title: Try-Catch Control Flow
questions.explanation: x becomes 1. throw 1 bypasses the second x++. Catch block executes, adding e (which is 1) to x (which is 1), resulting in 2.

questions.title: Post-Increment in Conditionals
questions.explanation: a++ evaluates to 1 (true), so the right side (b++) is short-circuited and not executed. a becomes 2, b remains 1.

questions.title: For Loop Variable Updates
questions.explanation: Iteration 1: i=0, becomes 1 in body, prints 1. loop inc makes i=2. Iteration 2: i=2, becomes 3 in body, prints 3. loop inc makes i=4. Iteration 3: i=4, becomes 5 in body, prints 5. loop inc makes i=6. Condition 6<5 is false.

questions.title: Do-While nested in While
questions.explanation: x=3. y=3, prints 3, y=2. prints 2, y=1. Loop ends. x=2. y=2, prints 2, y=1. Loop ends. x=1. y=1, prints 1, y=0. 0>1 false. Total: 3221.

questions.title: Exception in Loop
questions.explanation: i=1: sum=1. i=2: sum=1+2=3. Throws. Loop terminates instantly. Catch block multiplies sum by 2. 3*2 = 6.

questions.title: Recursive Array Processing
questions.explanation: process(5) reads arr[4] (5) + process(3). process(3) reads arr[2] (3) + process(1). process(1) reads arr[0] (1) + process(-1). process(-1) returns 0. 5 + 3 + 1 = 9.

questions.title: Goto Statements
questions.explanation: x=0. start: x=1, x=2. skip: prints 2. 2<3 true. start: x=3, if x==2 false, x=4. skip: prints 4. 4<3 false. Output: 24.

questions.title: Comma Operator in For Loop
questions.explanation: Iteration 1: i=0, j=5, prints 5. Iteration 2: i=1, j=4, prints 5. Iteration 3: i=2, j=3, prints 5.

questions.title: While Loop with Assignment
questions.explanation: x=5. y=5, x=4. y is 5 (odd). x=4. y=4, x=3. y is 4 (even), prints 4. x=3. y=3, x=2. y is 3 (odd). x=2. y=2, x=1. y is 2 (even), prints 2. x=1. y=1, x=0. y is 1 (odd). x=0. y=0, x=-1. y is 0 (evaluates to false in while condition). Loop ends.

questions.title: Switch without Breaks
questions.explanation: Since there are no break statements, matching case 2 starts execution, which then falls through cases 3 and 4 unconditionally.

questions.title: Ternary Operator Chaining
questions.explanation: a>b (10>20) is false. It evaluates the else part: (b>c) ? b : c. b>c (20>30) is false. It evaluates the else part: c (30).

questions.title: Nested Functions (Lambdas)
questions.explanation: f is called with x=3. Inside f, g is called with y=2. g returns x(3) + y(2) + v(5). 3+2+5 = 10. v is captured by reference and was changed to 5 before f was called.

questions.title: Complex Loop Conditions
questions.explanation: i=0,j=10 (print 0). i=1,j=8 (print 1). i=2,j=6 (print 2). i=3,j=4. Loop terminates because j>5 is false.

questions.title: Static and Global Variable Tracing
questions.explanation: First call: g=2, s=2, l=2. Second call: g=3, s=3 (persisted), l=2 (reinitialized).

questions.title: Short-Circuit with Side Effects
questions.explanation: First if: check(a, false) increments a to 1 and returns false. The && short-circuits. Output a (1). Second if: check(a, true) increments a to 2 and returns true. The || short-circuits. Output a (2).

questions.title: Multiple Recursion Tree
questions.explanation: tree(3): prints 3. Calls tree(2) and tree(1). tree(2): prints 2. Calls tree(1) and tree(0). tree(1): prints 1, calls tree(0) and tree(-1). Back to tree(2)'s second call: tree(0) does nothing. Back to tree(3)'s second call: tree(1) prints 1. Total: 3, 2, 1, 1.

questions.title: Reference Return and Assignment
questions.explanation: getVal returns a reference to nums[1]. The assignment getVal() = 50 directly modifies the array element at index 1.

questions.title: Exception Stack Unwinding
questions.explanation: obj1 constructed (C1). func called. obj2 constructed (C2). throw 1 initiates stack unwinding. Local objects are destroyed in reverse order of creation: obj2 (D2), obj1 (D1). Then the catch block executes (E).

questions.title: Pointer to Pointer Tracing
questions.explanation: pp points to p1. *pp = p2 changes p1 to point to b. **pp = 3 dereferences pp to get p1 (which points to b), and dereferences again to modify b to 3. a remains 1.

questions.title: Multi-dimensional Array Offsets
questions.explanation: Multi-dimensional arrays are contiguous in memory. p points to the first element (1). Adding 4 moves the pointer 4 elements forward: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. It points to 5.
